title: heliotropium fruticosum var. ternatum
intro: Heliotropium fruticosum var. ternatum, commonly known as Ternate heliotrope, is a plant species belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant, antiussive, and antipyretic properties, making it a potential treatment for conditions like bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Heliotropium fruticosum var. ternatum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
